I read this as [research] - fetch authoritative 2026 sources (developers.cloudflare.com, cloudflare/workers-sdk, honojs/hono) on DO WebSocket hibernation, wrangler.jsonc config, Hono upgrade routing, custom domains, alarms, and testing; produce a single markdown report with verifiable URLs and code snippets.

Firing first wave of parallel fetches for the canonical doc pages and repo metadata.

Wave 1 returned the canonical DO WebSockets page (hibernation API, full code), the static-assets page, and the alarms page. Several pages 404'd or overflowed the buffer (custom-domains, vitest-config, wrangler configuration). Cloudflare doc pages expose a markdown alternate at `index.md` which is far smaller — I'll fetch those. I also need the DO state/base API pages (for `acceptWebSocket(ws, tags)` and `webSocketError`), the migrations reference (for `new_sqlite_classes` vs `new_classes` and the free-plan requirement), the DO limits page (min alarm interval), the testing pages, and Hono's official docs.

Firing wave 2 in parallel.

I have nearly everything. The Hono getting-started page confirms Hono's module-worker pattern (`export default app`, `c.env` bindings, `wrangler types --env-interface`) and points to a dedicated Hono example "Cloudflare Durable Objects" at `/examples/cloudflare-durable-objects`. Fetching that one remaining page for the authoritative Hono + DO WebSocket routing snippet. I also have the workers-sdk HEAD SHA (`6e0bf6e9...`) and honojs/hono HEAD SHA (`26d8e42b...`) for permalink construction if needed.
